content:
q08. **Driver — `store/driver.go`** (interface defined at `store/driver.go:10`)

All database backend implementations (e.g. MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite drivers) implement `store.Driver`, which declares the full set of CRUD operations (e.g. `CreateMemo`, `ListMemos`, `CreateUser`, `GetDB`, etc.) that each backend must provide.
